The main takeaway from our work is that
we can now search for gravitational waves with a network of cryogenic bar detectors, and we can now search with a network of bar detectors for gravitational waves from astrophysical events.
the network is sensitive to bursts with a rate of 1 yr(-1) and an amplitude of 10(-21) to 10(-20) Hz(-1) at a few kHz.
the network of resonant detectors is a powerful tool to detect gravitational wave bursts and that the search for bursts with a network is feasible and can be performed routinely.
